# TPC-Havoc Q17_v3

```{tags} reference, query-template, tpchavoc
```

> [TPC-Havoc](../../tpc-havoc.md) benchmark · [all TPC-Havoc queries](index.md)

## Representative SQL

Rendered for **DataFusion** with default parameters.

```sql
SELECT
  SUM(l_extendedprice) / 7.0 AS avg_yearly
FROM lineitem AS l
INNER JOIN part AS p
  ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey
INNER JOIN (
  SELECT
    l_partkey,
    0.2 * AVG(l_quantity) AS threshold
  FROM lineitem
  GROUP BY
    l_partkey
) AS avg_calc
  ON l.l_partkey = avg_calc.l_partkey
WHERE
  p.p_brand = 'Brand#23'
  AND p.p_container = 'MED BOX'
  AND l.l_quantity < avg_calc.threshold
```
